INTRODUCTION

Guan Yin Bodhisattva (Avalokiteśvara), also known as Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva... He is great compassion, universally cures illness and suffering in the human world, and possesses immeasurable wisdom and supernatural powers. From countless previous lives, Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva had already become a Buddha, with the title "Truth Dharma Insight Tathagata". Because of his fervent thoughts of saving sentient beings and his considerate heart to save suffering, He turned the compassionate ship back to the earthly world, incarnating Bodhisattva, along with Manjushri Bodhisattva, Samantabhadra Bodhisattva and Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, known as the Four Great Bodhisattvas. Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva did not leave the Western Pure Land, but together with Amitābha Buddha and Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva formed the "Western Three Saints". At the same time, He also transformed into thousands of billions of millions of incarnations, appearing throughout the ten directions, countless Buddha lands, manifesting his physical body to save sentient beings.

Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva has extremely profound karma with sentient beings in the Saha world. He silently saves suffering, every wish is fulfilled, no wish is unfulfilled. The legends of spiritual inspiration from the past are countless and cannot be recorded all, so there is a saying that "Amitābha Buddha's house, Avalokiteśvara's house". Over thousands of years, Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara has reincarnated countless times. In the "Wonderful Dharma Lotus Sutra", the Buddha taught that: Whatever body sentient beings need to use to attain salvation, Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva immediately appears in that body to preach the Dharma. In Chinese history, those who were proclaimed as the reincarnation of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva included Liu Sa He (刘萨诃) of the Eastern Jin Dynasty, Great Venerable Bao Zhi Gong (宝志公) of the Southern Qi Liang Dynasty, the Great Monks of the Tang Dynasty... They were all not afraid to show off their powers and show off miracles.

In the 21st century today, there is also a great person who is known to practice Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara's compassionate vow to save people. That is the Chief of Oriental Radio in Sydney, Australia - Mr. Lu Quan Hoang. Dai Lu possesses heavenly eyesight, can rely on the year of birth, zodiac animal and gender provided by the person, not separated by space and time, to observe the position, shape, and color of the "totem", thereby understanding the person's past and present lives, as well as the cause and effect of retribution. Through this method, He helps people clearly understand the truth of cause and effect and retribution like shadow and form, thereby "do not do evil, do good", leading people to believe in Buddha, recite sutras, cultivate the mind and practice. This not only changes your own destiny but also improves society, purifies humanity's living space, and lays a solid foundation to escape the ocean of suffering in the six realms of samsara.

The "Spiritual Dharma Gate" is a powerful Dharma method suitable for the basic needs of modern sentient beings, transmitted by Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva to sentient beings today; This method belongs to Mahayana Buddhism. Radio director Lu Quan Hoanh, through radio and the internet, has tried his best to propagate the Spiritual Dharma, for thirty years like a day, saving people without charging a penny. On Dai Dai Lu's body, the spirit of salvation, saving humanity, "unconditioned great kindness, great compassion" of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva is deeply depicted.

“Spiritual Dharma” advocates three great Dharma treasures: Reciting Sutras, Making Vows and Releasing Life, helping people to save themselves and save others, to be self-aware and to enlighten others (to help others be enlightened), thereby escaping pain and illness, resolving conflicts and obstacles, and improving wisdom and character. Thanks to its miraculous effectiveness and quick effectiveness, in just five short years, this method has penetrated deeply into people's hearts and has tens of millions of followers worldwide.

The book series "Radio Chief Lu Quan Hoanh - Exposing the Buddha Dharma Dialogue Video" is one of the series of books edited by the Radio Dong Phuong Secretariat. This book mainly collects and publishes the content of Bach Thoai Buddha Dharma (Buddhist Dharma in everyday life) from the exposition videos of Dai Dai Lu Quan Hoanh, in order to help Buddhist friends through books and texts to learn more deeply the essence of Buddha Dharma, imbibe the benefits of the Dharma, and continuously increase merit and wisdom. and in every little bit of cultivating your mind and practicing, you accumulate self-satisfaction for rebirth in the Pure Land and the Four Noble Paths.

Pray that more and more predestined sentient beings can board the salvation boat of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva: Purify the soul, leave suffering and be happy, transcend afflictions, eliminate karma, transcend predestined people, pay off all unjust debts, save all sentient beings, ascend to Ultimate Bliss, strive to achieve the Four Saints.

1. Traveling to the Western Bliss to Meet the Deity Guan Yin Bodhisattva (Avalokiteśvara).

On December 18, 2018, after returning home from worshiping Buddha in the evening, the light spirit body was carried up to the heavens by several streams of golden pillars. In mid-air, the disciple met the dharma body of Namo Victorious Fighting Buddha, very tall and very big, wearing golden armor, holding a Golden Stick in his hand, waiting there for the disciple. The disciple's spirit body gently landed on the palm of Dou Chien Thang Buddha, and was led by Dou Chien Thang Buddha to quickly fly through many Thien Mons (heavenly gates) of the heavenly world (heaven). In an instant, he flew into the empty universe and flew past many planets. After flying past a system of stars, this planet is very large and beautiful, the outside is surrounded by a white halo and the gaseous state of the planet is brown and white. Dou Chien Thang Buddha used his thoughts to tell his disciples that this was Jupiter. Scientists used probes to find that it was just the symbol of Jupiter. In Jupiter there are palaces and celestial beings residing there. This is a world of spiritual beings (an invisible world) and Earth is the land of Saha.

The disciple used the heavenly eye to observe the appearance of many planets, some planets were dark and turbid, and some planets had brightly colored or white auras. The dark, murky planet is the world of evil realms, the planet with slightly weak light is the Asura heavenly realm (near Earth), and the place with white light and colorful seven-colored aura belongs to the realm of desire and the realm of form, the realm of formlessness is outside the Milky Way system and currently scientists cannot explore and discover the world there. Dou Chien Thang Buddha advised his disciples to withdraw their thoughts (concentrate their thoughts) and not look at these planetary systems anymore. After finishing speaking, Dou Chien Thang Buddha increased his speed and led his disciples to fly at extremely fast speeds, thousands of times faster than the speed of a Meteor traveling in the empty universe. Flying through many star systems (Milky Way system), I don't know how long it took (it felt like 7-8 minutes).

From afar, the disciple saw a system of planets emitting a brilliant halo of golden light that dazzled the eyes. Before he could get close, he felt very warm, just like when the disciple finished worshiping Buddha at the Guanyin Hall, feeling that behind him there was a warm, warm air spreading very comfortably.

Fighting Victory Buddha used his thoughts to tell his disciples that ahead was the Western World of Ultimate Bliss. The Western world of Ultimate Bliss is truly as the Buddhist scriptures say it must go through ten trillion Buddhists to reach it. Without the support of Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, it is really impossible to reach, the journey is too far, we have to go through many planetary systems, the trajectory of the Milky Way system is extremely complicated.

Coming to this golden halo planet, the Vajra Dharma Protector of the Western World of Ultimate Bliss appeared holding a Dharma weapon in his hand and asked, Dou Chien Thang Buddha used his mind to tell the Vajra Dharma Protector that the disciple is a disciple traveling to the underworld of the Spiritual Dharma Gate, and is now here to meet Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva. Vajrayana Dharma Protector gently clasped his hands and let it go. Pass through the dazzling golden light and reach the entrance in the sky of the Western World of Ultimate Bliss. As soon as he flew into the Western World of Ultimate Bliss, the whole air was peaceful and pure, the sound of stream after stream of Dharma sounds reciting the Buddha's name not far away echoed, the body and mind became extremely pure, lotus flowers automatically appeared at the disciples' feet.

Fighting Victory Buddha told his disciples: "East of the Western World of Ultimate Bliss and slightly tilted to the left is the Spiritual Pure Land, the world where disciples who have cultivated and attained enlightenment in the future will be reborn and live here. Today we will go to the center of the Pure Land of Western Bliss to meet the Deity Guan Yin Bodhisattva (Avalokiteśvara)." As soon as he finished speaking, Dou Chien Thang Buddha led his disciples to fly to the center of the Western Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss (The Western world of Ultimate Bliss is too large, please forgive the disciples for not being able to fully describe the appearance of the pure land) right at the time when the three Western saints were preaching the Dharma to educate the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, their Dharma meaning was profound and profound. The disciple's intention (realm) cannot be explained (it is beyond the disciple's understanding).

After the disciples asked for peace from the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva waved a willow branch and a pure vase appeared in the disciple's hand. Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva instructed his disciples to take it to Hell for the souls of sinners to drink. The pure vase contains the energy of the Seven Treasures of Eight Merit Waters.

Buddha asked his disciples: "You have also encountered internal and external demons that hinder your spiritual practice. How can you eliminate them?"

The disciple replied: "With the strong will to believe in Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva to overcome difficulties, at that time he also knelt in front of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva and cried, and relied on [Buddhist Dialogue] Buddha's Speech and Buddha's Language, recording his master's instructions at the Dharma conference so that he could persevere in his mind."

Bodhisattva Samantabhadra: "Travel to hell many times. Why do some disciples go from a firm belief to backsliding and slandering the Buddha? What is the disciple's understanding (view) of this issue?"

The disciple replied: "There are disciples who do not have confidence in the Buddha Dharma, who do not try to penetrate to understand and understand the profound and profound meaning of the Buddha Dharma; but there are some disciples who think about the Dharma to a too complicated level without knowing the simplicity of the Tao, leading to lost practice; there are also some disciples who look at the teacher's mistakes and develop prejudices, and then make big mistakes that cannot be reversed."

Manjushri Bodhisattva: "What Dharma is right? And what is not right?"

The disciple replied: "Relying on conscience is the right nature"

Manjushri Bodhisattva: "So the disciple who slanders like that, does he have a conscience or not?"

The disciple replied: "No, but their ignorance and ignorance is truly pitiful, and it is also an evil phenomenon of the end of the dharma. The human heart is bewitched by the five desires, with deep bad habits, so it is difficult to clear the mind and see one's nature."

Fighting Victory Buddha: "How to wash away the dust of the world?"

The disciple replied: "Repent so that you can gain great light, repentance can make your mind pure."

Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva: "Your cultivation level is not enough, you should try harder, develop a heart of compassion and compassion for sentient beings, and widely spread the giving of the Dharma more to benefit predestined sentient beings. Go quickly, don't let the King Yama wait too long. "

After finishing speaking, Dou Chien Thang Buddha gently lifted up his disciple's lotus flower, and left the Western World of Ultimate Bliss at extremely fast speed to reach Guan Di's palace. Bodhisattva Bodhisattva Bodhisattva gave the disciple a scroll and instructed the disciple a few sentences before sending the disciple's soul to Hell.

(Note: The content at Dia Phu listens to the judge, this book is compiled and arranged in a unified manner in "The next part witnesses the scene of Hell and at Dia Phu listens to the judge". For details, see: Article 11. At the Diem Palace, listen to the judge, a sinner who is a media person who has twice recanted and slandered).

Question: On December 23, 2018, the spiritual body was carried to Heaven by a stream of golden light. In mid-air, the Buddha wearing a golden robe shined and sparkled. He used his hand to hold and lift the disciple's soul with extremely fast speed and led the disciple to fly through many Thien Mons (heavenly gates) through the Desire World, the Form World (the galaxy) and the Formless World (several planets outside the galaxy), entering the void of the universe, passing through countless pure lands of the Buddha's country, and when arriving at the entrance of the Western World of Ultimate Bliss, the Dharma Protector Vajra appeared incarnated to ask the Bodhisattva Saint who came to visit the Western World of Ultimate Bliss. After answering this question, Vajra Dharma Protector accepted him into the Western World of Ultimate Bliss.

When entering the Western World of Ultimate Bliss, the lotus flower naturally appeared at the disciple's feet, and the lotus stem was still surrounded by a little pale gray-white gas. Dou Chien Thang Buddha used his thoughts to tell his disciples: "I have the will of Quan Yin to take you to travel to the Spiritual Pure Land." Having finished speaking, the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas took their disciples from the entrance of the Western Pure Land to the east and turned to the left in a large circle. Not far away, a giant circular tower of golden light sparkled, there was a Thien Mon (heaven's gate) higher than the Nam Thien Mon (Nam Thien gate) erected at the entrance to the Pure Land, and a yellow sign inscribed with the words "Pure Land Spirituality".

The Vajra Dharma Protector protecting the Spiritual Pure Land holding a dharma weapon at the entrance of Thien Mon (heaven's gate) appeared and asked: "Who is this? This is a Spiritual holy place, no trespass is allowed." Dou Chien Thang Buddha in mid-air used his thoughts to convey the words: "I am Dou Chien Thang Buddha, with the will of Quan Yin, to lead Buddhists of the Spiritual Dharma to travel to the Pure Land and will rewrite the Holy Land of the Pure Land to pass on to future sentient beings."

The disciple received the approval of Vajra Dharma Protector and then flew through Thien Mon and entered the Spiritual Pure Land. In the distance, a sparkling Golden Dragon (Golden Dragon) flew in, the scales on the Dragon's body were iridescent, radiating a stream of golden light, and the Dragon's whiskers were flying with the wind. Kim Long flew close to the disciple and used his mind to say to the disciple: "Young child, please ride on my body. I will obey Quan Am's will and take you to the Quan Am village ashram."

The disciple used his mind to control the lotus flower to fly to the body of the Golden Dragon (Buddhas and Bodhisattvas in the Pure Land world all have supernatural powers and can manifest at will). It seemed like the Golden Dragon was slow, but in fact it flew over the mountains at a very fast speed, and arrived on the mountain in a very large place of the Bodhisattva Bodhisattva Quan Am village. When the disciples rode the Dragon and flew over the mountains, and these mountains in the fluttering mist also appeared many ashrams in Quan Am village arranged in many places.

Kim Long flew his disciples to the center of the ashram of Quan Am village, in front of a giant statue of Avalokitesvara Dong Phuong, and the disciples stopped in the air nearby. The disciples knelt down to worship Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva. The Holy Statue of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva emitted golden light. The Dharma Body of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva appeared in front of the disciple, telling the disciple to bathe in the Bao Tri Merit Water lake, washing away the dirt of the world.

The Golden Dragon received Bodhisattva's will and landed from the sky. The disciples rode the Golden Dragon and flew to Bao Tri Cong Duc Thuy Lake not far from here. The fountain sometimes emitted golden light, sometimes it turned into seven colorful halos. The disciple stood on the lotus flower and landed on the water.

A moment later, the lotus flower disappeared from under the feet, the disciple's spiritual body bathed in the lake, the water in the lake was clear blue, one could see the bottom of the lake covered with sparkling gold and golden light. In the water, the disciple feels his whole body is serene and peaceful, the thoughts of human afflictions under the washing of the water in the lake are almost completely eliminated. Before long, Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara's voice came from the sky: "Dear child, the dirt of the mortal world has been cleansed, please leave the lake." The disciple's spiritual body slowly flew out of the lake and lotus flowers began to appear at the disciple's feet. The lotus stem is also washed by the water in Bao Tri Lake, so the light gray white gas is no longer visible when the disciple has just entered the Western World of Ultimate Bliss.

The disciple bowed his head and looked at the water in Bao Tri Lake, which was still so clean and clear. It was so strange. He couldn't help but admire the mighty divine power of Bodhisattva Avalokiteśvara. In mid-air, the Dharma sound of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva came again: "Dear child, XX Bodhisattva is waiting for you at the Tu Sutra Pavilion, go there and listen to the Dharma." The disciple stepped on the lotus flower and flew into the air. The Golden Dragon in the air guided the disciple to Tu Kinh Cac.

When arriving at a pavilion built halfway up the mountain, an Elder Bodhisattva laughed hahaha... inviting his disciples to sit on a white jade chair, Kim Long transformed into the form of a pupil with braided hair and sat listening to the Dharma. On the white jade table is a map of the universe. The Bodhisattva explains in detail to his disciples the stellar universe system (Evil Realm, Desire Realm, Form Realm, Formless Realm), the mysteries of the celestial bodies of each heaven containing the intention of practice. When I heard about it, I was fascinated as if I was intoxicated. I truly benefited a lot.

After listening to all the Dharma sounds of Old Bodhisattva, the Dharma body of Victorious Fighting Buddha appeared in the Spiritual Pure Land, reminding his disciples that the time has come, it is time to return to Yang World.

The disciple who followed Victorious Fighting Buddha flew at extremely fast speed, left the Spiritual Pure Land, flew through the entrance of the Western World of Ultimate Bliss, reported to Vajra Dharma Protector and then entered the void of the universe, passed through countless Milky Way systems, returned to the realm of desire, passed through the Southern Heaven Gate, flew into the sky of the country where the disciple lived, through layers of darkness of the human world, the disciple's soul was protected by Dharma Protector. The Bodhisattva returns to the body, and the disciple's consciousness awakens. It was after 3 a.m.

Disciple 2018-12-23

Answer: This person is very powerful. In the past, people called "Three Jewels Disciples" whose soul could go to heaven and earth, then this person was extremely pure. Normally, it is the body of a teenager who can convey this kind of information.

December 26, 2018, Pure Land Spiritual scene:

The Golden Dragon (Golden Dragon) is flying in the air and the air in the Pure Land world is extremely pure, the incarnation of Guan Yin Bodhisattva (Avalokiteśvara) is always appearing in the air, and line after line of Buddha's voice echoes in the mountains. The disciple randomly followed his thoughts and a number counter appeared in the human world when the disciple recited the sutra to help the disciple remember the number of sutra changes (times) (a blue number counter that is worn on the finger) and so the disciple started reciting this sutra and then continued on to the next. The counting machine changes color depending on the disciple's thoughts, sometimes it's blue, sometimes it's orange. Just like that, all the sutras in the daily exercises were completed.

Answer: Do people have to wait until everyone is about to "Go" before believing? People dream and see everything. As long as there is a clean place, that place is everyone's pure land. Question: On January 13, 2019, the day Śākyamuni Buddha attained enlightenment, at 12 a.m. that day, the disciple saw with his own eyes the golden light above the room, and soon the disciple's consciousness fell into a coma. The spiritual body is covered with streams of golden light. In the middle of the sky, there are Victorious Fighting Buddha and Vi Da Bodhisattva waiting to welcome the disciple's spiritual body, using the concept to tell the disciple that today, according to the Buddha's will, he will escort the disciple to the Western World of Ultimate Bliss to attend the conference of the Buddha country.

With extremely fast speed, surpassing countless constant stars in the universe and the pure land of Buddha, finally reaching the entrance to the Western World of Ultimate Bliss, Vajra Dharma Protector appeared and asked the disciple. After asking, he let the disciple enter the Western World of Ultimate Bliss. Dharma Protector Bodhisattva escorts his disciples to the center of the Pure Land to meet the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas. The disciples bowed to all the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas of the Ten Directions and Three Worlds and stood at the lower seat (under the tent) of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva to listen to the Dharma. In front of the lotus of Guan Yin Bodhisattva (Avalokiteśvara), his disciples were as small as a speck of dust. Today, the Western World of Ultimate Bliss is filled with the joy of the Dharma. All the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas joyfully praise (joyfully praise) the Buddha when he preached the Dharma in the land of Saha, his merits are inconceivable.

Amitābha Buddha: “Do you know the Compassionate Vow of Avalokiteshvara?”

Children: "I once heard about the twelve great vows of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva on an online Buddhist site."

Amitābha Buddha: "Leading to that pure land is the original vow of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva and the Spiritual Dharma Door is based on the twelve great vows of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva that created the Western Buddhas' hope that Buddhists everywhere return to the Buddha country and join the conference."(returning to Buddha's country to participate in the conference)

Buddha Shakyamuni: "How do you explain the two words Shakyamuni pupil?" Disciple: “Mercy.”

Buddha Shakyamuni: "In the Buddha's Dharma, neither cause nor kindness can fulfill the Buddha's path."

Manjushri Bodhisattva: "The 《Buddha Dharma Talk》 is a combination of Buddha's scriptures, and also contains the Dharma meaning of Buddhas and Bodhisattvas. Buddhists must really use their minds to comprehend it."

Universal Bodhisattva: "Avalokiteśvara has compassion for all people in the world, especially sending his disciples' masters to the world to spread the profound meaning of Buddhist scriptures. All Buddhists in the world should not betray Avalokiteśvara's wishes. How many people are there who truly practice Buddha's vows?"

Vajra Dharma Protector: "All Buddhists who have broken their vows and broken the precepts should repent. The Buddha has opened the door of compassion, don't stay there without awakening. Vajra Dharma Realm punishes harshly and without mercy!"

The Venerable Ananda: "When the Buddha was in the world, I was in front of the seat (Buddha's place) listening to the Dharma with respect and politeness, fear and anxiety, not daring to be negligent. Disciples of Senior Lu Quan Hoang Dai, do you know that the Buddha Dharma is difficult to hear and masters are difficult to meet?"

King Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva: "In the Saha World, during the Dharma Ending Period, such evil disciples (slanderous disciples) appeared, which truly made all the Buddhas in the Western Pure Land lament sadly, and the fact that they had to be in hell to be punished was also something that Quan Yin could not bear to see, so he ordered his disciples to go down to the underworld (hell) to protect the Buddha Dharma and help the right path."

Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva: "You should try to protect the dharma, don't be negligent."

Master: "Thanks to the compassion and mercy of the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, this child is still very weak." Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva: "Try to teach and teach."

The disciple shamelessly bowed to the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas. Not long after, a Golden Phoenix (yellow phoenix) came to take the disciple to the Spiritual Pure Land to recite Buddha's name.

Thank you, Master.

Disciple 2019-01-13

Answer: Each teacher has their own personality, your teacher's personality is like that, in front of the Bodhisattva he even said that his pupils were poor. Bodhisattvas in Heaven are truly compassionate, just like us humans, compassionate people are together, each person says one word, each person teaches one sentence, reminds one sentence, in fact we should practice diligently, giving everyone more suggestions. From many Buddhist scriptures, we can see how compassionate the Bodhisattva is. Inside there is a saying "What does Shakyamuni mean?" Do you all know now? That is Mercy .

Question: On January 18, 2019, at noon at the group meditation meeting after finishing worshiping Buddha and Bodhisattva and when the disciples sat down to recite sutras, Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara transmitted the thought to the disciples to write down the wonderful scene of the disciples' souls traveling inside Maitreya Monastery, listening and comprehending the Buddha's Dharma sounds at the Linh Son Dharma Assembly in Thien Thuong (heaven) in December. Disciples Riding a Golden Dragon (golden dragon), the dragon's beard flutters in the wind, the golden dragon's scales sparkle. The Golden Dragon carries the disciple on its body, sometimes hiding in the clouds, sometimes flying and dancing in circles. When the disciple sits on the dragon's body, he does not feel dizzy, only feels light and peaceful in body and mind, so wonderful that it cannot be described in words. In front of the eyes is a Thien Mon (heaven's gate) on a sign with three words "Maitreya Institute". After flying through Thien Mon, there are many temples with ancient architectural styles. Kim Long carries disciples flying through the Maitreya front yard at high speed (Matreya ashram in Thien Thuong occupies a large area) and the back yard has a Thien Mon that is a passage directly connected to the six outer Heavenly paths. After passing through the Thien Mon Gate of Hau Vien, in the distance a giant mountain peak appeared (Mount Tu-Di). The Golden Dragon circled along the top of the mountain and flew very fast. Occasionally, there are tall Heavenly Men, Heavenly Women (fairies) and Venerable Men who fly past their disciples very quickly. The Heavenly Men in the Heavens (in the sky) have many different forms, including the powerful and dignified Dharma Guardian Angels in golden armor, and the Heavenly Ladies with flexible bodies and gently fluttering dresses.

(Dress: traditional Hanfu fairy costume). Soon, Kim Long led his disciples to fly to a flat stone platform on the mountain and landed there. Devas and Goddesses from all worlds gathered here to listen and comprehend the Dharma (teachings) of the Buddha. Miraculous sound waves came from the outer space not far away, Golden Phoenix (golden phoenix) and Golden Dragon (golden dragon) flew from the Western World of Ultimate Bliss to Linh Son to support and protect the Dharma Assembly, and in their mouths continuously chanted: "Let us welcome the Buddha and His Venerables to Linh Son." Soon, the disciple's consciousness fell into a sleepy state, the disciple's soul was surrounded by streams of golden light, and lotus flowers appeared at the disciple's feet. Lake: Seven bowls of merit water) of the Spiritual Pure Land for bathing.

Under the disciple's lotus base, which was originally transparent white, but surrounded by water and golden sand (golden sand) in the lake, the disciple's lotus stem began to transform and emit brilliant golden light. The consciousness of the enormous dharma body of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva appeared in the air and said to the disciple: "Dear child, this is the Eightfold Merit Water that you obtained when you traveled to witness the underworld and reported it, and now the merit energy has settled in your lotus stem. Your Master's dharma body has arrived in the Western World of Ultimate Bliss. Go to the lotus pond at Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva's place and pick the Seven Jeweled Lotus Flowers to give to your Master." After the Bodhisattva finished speaking, a golden dragon (golden dragon) flew to lead the disciples to the lotus pond at the place of Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva. There were countless lotus flowers of all colors emitting five-colored light. Bodhisattvas and Vajra Protectors of different levels were sitting solemnly on the lotus throne, with a calm and relaxed attitude.

The golden dragon landed on a colorful lotus flower much larger in size than four or five wheels. On that lotus flower displayed the merits that have been recorded about the Master's propagation of Buddhism in the Saha world. The disciple raised his hand to pick the lotus flower but with his mind (meaning he only thought in his head, not using the actual movement of reaching out to pick it), from the lotus came the Master's Dharma voice: "Do you know what this is? These are the seven treasures of merit that Master Spread the Dharma in the Saha world. Please try to practice. The disciple replied: Karma arises from the mind. All things arise from the mind, body, speech, and mind to create karma. Sentient beings are confused and attached to the signs of the evil world. If they keep their mind unmoved and not be fascinated by the signs, and their mind does not arise depending on the situation, then their karma will be eliminated.

Buddhists studying Spiritual Dharma should skillfully apply the combination of Buddhist scriptures (Little House (XFZ)) to transcend souls. The great compassion of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva can help liberate sentient beings in the six paths from suffering. From now on, in all cases heard in the underworld, my dharma body of consciousness will accompany my students to the underworld. Having finished speaking, the disciple and Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva flew into the underworld passage.

May Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva be compassionate and merciful to the disciples, allowing the disciples' sharing to be transmitted to the earthly world to warn future humans: do not commit sexual misconduct, hell really exists! noi_dung:
6. At the King's Palace, Heard the Trial of the sexual misconduct Case That Led to the Unfaithful Man's Unfaithful Man Jumping to Suicide.

The Great King Yama told his disciples: The Dharma Protectors and Bodhisattvas of the Spiritual Dharma have issued holy orders to go to hell to specifically send a male sinner, a heartless, ungrateful man, who committed suicide out of love in the trial two days ago from hell to here. Let this King convey a warning to sentient beings on earth about the hellish consequences of infidelity, meaninglessness, and wanton sexual misconduct. Living beings in this world should not think that men and women can secretly commit sexual misconduct and be irresponsible with their feelings. After death, the underworld will record every single thing, the cause and effect of retribution is completely true, not false.

Dai King Yama Gia shouted at the guilty spirit: Hometown Ha

Sinful man: I was wrong, I don't have the heart to learn Buddhist chanting. That time, XXX and her Spiritual Dharma practice group went out to preach the Dharma in XX city. I saw that she was beautiful so I approached her. But the surrounding brothers protected her very carefully, especially her mother. She often went out with the group meditation group to propagate the Dharma. I pretended to be interested in Buddhism to chat and ask for friends on WeChat. Every day I intentionally went online to find Buddhist questions to ask her. I know she is honest and naive. Gradually, I was also influenced by the Buddha's teachings. I often studied Buddhism and recited sutras, and often joined the monks in propagating the Dharma locally.

Maybe because of my past life, I really like her. I know Master teaches that when men and women are together, they must have a pure mind and not watch things they shouldn't.  I also see that I used to be very promiscuous and knew a lot of girls. After studying Buddhism, I also tried to get rid of bad habits. I was young and full of energy. I was an impulsive young man who studied Buddhism for a while and still couldn't control my desires. I went online to watch depraved movies and secretly started thinking about her. She looked like an XX star. After that, I had evil thoughts, started pursuing XXX, and gave many expensive gifts.

Here, I would like to advise girls in this world: no guy will give precious gifts for no reason if everyone is truly interested in studying Buddhism. If you do not intend to develop feelings, please do not accept any unreasonable kindness from men. Most men have a purpose when being nice. Master teaches us men and women to keep the precepts  not to commit sexual misconduct; Hell really exists! Don't die like me...(cry of sin)

Gradually, over time, we fell in love and became lovers, then took a step forward in our relationship. I didn't know she had taken a vow not to commit sexual misconduct. Then she got pregnant and wanted to get married and have children. I'm still so young, my parents won't agree to let me marry her. Before, I promised to marry her and just lied to her. She was very naive.

I also don't plan to get married so soon. I advised her to have an abortion, she cried, I didn't pay attention to that determined attitude, and in the end still aborted the baby. Over time, I felt like she was being stubborn and had a strange temper, so I always found an excuse to break up and stop seeing each other. Unexpectedly, she thought about it and jumped off the building to commit suicide

One day, I went to a nightclub looking for female friends to have fun while driving when I suddenly lost consciousness, leading to a car crash and death.  After I died, I found out that she was always crying in front of the King Yama, and was allowed by the underworld to go to earth to take my life. After my death, I was thrown into the Hell of the Manure Cellar, in there being bitten by hundreds of thousands of worms, both painful and aching and stinking, the suffering was indescribable. If you haven't gone to hell, you don't know that pain.

Dai King Yama Gia: At such a young age, he was so enthusiastic that after studying Buddhism and reciting sutras, he had no sincere intention and did not change his ways. He deceived the feelings of the female student of Buddhism XXX. After committing suicide, her mother began to doubt that the Buddha Dharma had regressed and did not recite the sutras. For forty-nine days, no one transcended. While being punished in hell, every day she resented you for being heartless and meaningless. You were always committing sexual misconduct in the earthly world. The underworld checked the book to record that your positive life had expired due to excessive sexual pleasure. The underworld deducted the positive life of the sinful spirit and sent her spirit body back to the earthly world. She entered your body, knowing full well that when you were alive, you played with her emotions, and even died without regret.

When you were having fun with your girlfriend, she stood next to you and watched. When you were driving home, she intentionally possessed you and turned the steering wheel, causing an accident that left you dead on the spot. After taking revenge, she was sent back to hell to be punished by the devil. The student traveling to the Cold Ice Hell met XXX; XXX knew that the student was studying the Spiritual Dharma, so he cried and told the story in front of the student. The pupil advised her to recite the name Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva in hell. Because she was reciting the Buddha's name when she was born, Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva in heaven heard the sound of XXX's suffering, and immediately sent the pupil to travel to the underworld to record the case of XXX's previous birth and hell retribution to warn sentient beings on earth, and use these merits to release her from hell.

You are heartless and meaningless and have nothing to justify. After suffering the punishment in hell, she will be reincarnated as a poor woman. In the next life, she will meet XXX again, due to the convergence of fate to repay a few years of emotional debt. Evil fate and sinful souls will treat XXX very well for no reason, while XXX in the next life will be ungrateful.

The disciple deeply laments when the injustice and retribution will end, reincarnation is truly endless

This King advises men and women in the world that sexual desire between men and women is nothing more than the combination of flesh and blood. Indulging in these desires will only cause you to lose your life and virtue. After death, you will have to meet the King Yama and be sentenced to hell to be punished. The feelings between men and women cannot be played around with.

After speaking, the disciple's soul returned to the earthly world. When I woke up from the dream, it was after 9:00 a.m. The disciple overslept.

Disciple  December 16, 2018

Answer: It is absolutely true that stories like this absolutely cannot be made up. Many groups of fellow practitioners are like this, with many men entering first to see who is beautiful, and the children learning the Spiritual Dharma are all very simple, and the girls have all been very well-behaved by Master. They cheated, got hit by a car, died and then fell into hell. The sentence "Excessive enjoyment of sexual pleasures in hell will shorten the life of the sinful soul" is completely accurate and is severely deducted. Originally a person could live six or seventy years, but his life expectancy could be reduced by more than ten or twenty years.

7. At the Palace of King Yama, Heard the Trial of Two Spirits Who Created the Karma of Killing Living Beings, Studying Buddhism and Then Regressed, slandering the Buddha

Question: December 12, 2018  the disciple's soul was brought into the Palace of King Yama. Dai King Yama Gia and Tieu King Yama Gia saw the disciple coming and were a bit unhappy and scolded the disciple a few words.

The Great King Yama said: Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, with a very urgent heart to save people,  told you to quickly write down after returning to the earthly world, but sometimes you took several days to write it down. Assigned tasks must not be neglected or delayed.  I know that your body is a mortal, every time you return to this earthly world, your spirit is tired, but you also have to share the burden with your Master. Your master saves sentient beings day and night. As a Buddhist disciple, you should also complete well the tasks assigned by Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva

After hearing this, the disciple immediately bowed his head and apologized to Dai King Yama Gia. Standing next to him with his hands clasped to listen to the trial

Dai King Yama Gia continued: Even if the child can practice like today, when the King scolds him, he will still know how to bow his head and apologize. As for you, Spiritual Dharma disciples, after only being reprimanded by your master for a few sentences, you have retreated and not practiced, but eat salty food against your vows, go everywhere viciously and slander, fall into hell, and still ask why? Now Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva has compassion on you and has written an official dispatch to the underworld to bring up your spiritual entities. You must honestly declare. If you lie even half a sentence, I will increase the term of hell punishment. XXX you said it first :

Sinner A: I said, I am XXX, Thien X, Truong Gia village, country At the Dharma conference, my wife and I both witnessed with our own eyes the miraculous effectiveness of the Spiritual Dharma. After returning, we were even more diligent in our efforts to practice. I used to be a fish trader. After studying Buddhism, I stopped doing business and many times used myself as an example to advise people not to kill animals. My legs were not good and my heart was weak and I often had to use a wheelchair. After studying the Spiritual Dharma, thanks to chanting sutras, I gradually got better. Before studying Buddhism, I was lustful and my wife did not know this bad habit of mine. After marrying my wife, who was not highly educated, she helped me sell and kill fish.

I met my master a few times. He saw that I knew how to change my ways and praised me very much. I use my own story to help many people learn Buddhist chanting. But later I was no longer diligent, became lazy, and became more lustful. During group meditation sessions, I often kept my eyes on the beautiful female monks. A senior brother advised me many times, but I did not change this habit. One time when I went abroad to meet my master, he openly pointed out my shortcomings in front of everyone, and I felt embarrassed.

After returning, I stopped practicing, did not go to group meditation sessions, and stopped reciting. After that, my old habit relapsed and I dated a divorced woman in the village that my wife didn't know. A senior brother saw it and ran to tell my wife. I was so angry that I felt uncomfortable in my heart, and my temper was extremely hot-tempered when I was alive. I lied to my wife about all sorts of things, which influenced my wife to stop practicing and not attend group meditation anymore

King Yama Gia opened the projection screen, showing the sinners and their wives all over Truong Gia village telling others that their illnesses were cured by the hospital. The Spiritual Dharma they said was too mysterious, I don't know how real or fake it is, the cases of viewing totems by Master Lu Lu Quan Hoanh were also not real. Spiritual Dharma is smeared everywhere, affecting many people outside. I later did business with that woman.

My wife was relatively naive when she saw that she and I were close and didn't think much of it, just thinking it was business. One time, I took my wife and lover to pick up groceries on a winding mountain road. That day, for some reason, my mind was always hazy and I fell asleep for a bit before the car crashed into me and died on the spot. After death, he fell into the Avīci Hell (Relentless Hell) to suffer torture, molten lava poured into his mouth. It's pitiful, when I was alive I was a big and strong person, everyone gave three parts, but in hell there was no way to ask for help. It hurts so much! The lava is ten thousand degrees hot..." (sobbing)

King Yama Gia opened the screen and saw a black spiritual body that, before the accident, had pressed on the criminal's head, causing unconsciousness and leading to a fatal accident.

Dai King Yama Gia said: How pitiful! You withdrew and did not rectify the bondholder's injustice and did not receive the transcendence scriptures, so you were extremely resentful and went to the underworld to denounce him. The underworld examined your records and found out that you had backed away from cultivating while you had previously promised to save a large amount of scriptures. The spirit body, which was originally waiting in the underworld to be transcended and reincarnated, now knows that you have regressed. After receiving instructions from the King Yama, the ghosts immediately sent them to the earthly world to take your life. Not only did you influence the villagers, but you also caused your wife and you to fall into Hell. Now being punished in the Uninterrupted Hell, he is transferred to the Black Guy Hell, day and night tied to a post to suffer, his stomach bursting and his intestines leaking because he used to be a fish trader and created the karma of killing. Waiting for the heavenly edict to be given, I will also arrange for your spirit body to go to earth, so that sentient beings will know clearly the retribution of killing lives and suffering the retribution of falling to Hell

Sinner B: My name is XXX, from Malaysia XXX, city X. In 201X, I met Spiritual Dharma through YouTube. I run a seafood restaurant and my child has a brain disease. At that time, there was no group meditation group in the locality, so I had to go to another state to get scriptures to bring back and start reciting the sutras. In 201X, I worshiped a local monk.

After I worshiped the monk, I invited my wife to meditate together. After reciting the sutra, my child's brain disease changed very quickly. I also dreamed many times that Master, Guan Yin Bodhisattva (Avalokiteśvara) and other Buddhas and Bodhisattvas often came to bless me. But because of the job of killing living beings, I am ignorant and do not understand, I do not follow the instructions closely, I do not read the Buddha's Teachings every day, I just blindly recite the sutras.

I have a relative who practices another method and she says the XXX method is good. I did not have true faith in my Master, so I quit and practiced another method. After practicing the XXX method, I continuously created bad verbal karma of speaking ill of the Spiritual Dharma, affecting the Dharma propagation of the local group meditation

Practiced the XXX method for a while and found that it was not spiritual, so I stopped practicing. After my child recovered from his illness, after I stopped practicing, his illness relapsed. I don't consider why my life is so miserable, I only blame heaven and earth, feeling that praying to gods and worshiping Buddha is not spiritual.

King Yama Gia opened the screen and saw the sinful spirit and his wife going everywhere creating verbal karma for the Spiritual Dharma. He had no understanding of Buddhism at all, but was in other ashrams talking nonsense and slandering the Spiritual Dharma, causing people who studied Buddhism in other methods to have a negative view of the Spiritual Dharma. After that, even though he no longer practiced the XXX method, the sinful spirit continued to stay in every place in his town, creating verbal karma, saying that that XXX method was not good

Then the criminal drove too fast on the highway and crashed into a roadside guard fence and the car broke down and the person died. Before the accident, the underworld brought in many small black spirits, all of which were water creatures that were killed by sinful souls while trading in seafood and entered the body of sinful souls to claim their lives.

You were originally saved by Buddha's teachings, and your brain disease was also blessed by the Bodhisattva and changed for good. As long as you continue to persevere in reciting the sutras to overcome the wronged family, transform your killing karma and cultivate your mind to be good, then even though you cannot be reborn in the Pure Land of Buddha in this life, you can still be born in the Heavenly Realm to enjoy the blessings of Heaven. Unfortunately, just because of a foolish thought, you can retreat and not practice, even if you practice other Buddhist methods, you cannot persevere. Blaming heaven and earth, why don't you think back to the evil things you did that caused you to be reincarnated into a poor family? Again, driven by his own karma, he became a killer and opened a seafood restaurant to make a living.

Although I pity you because of the karma created by ignorance, the retribution for slandering the Buddha Dharma and killing living beings cannot be avoided. You still have to endure the Avīci Hell (Relentless Hell) and then transfer to the Black Rope Hell

Share your case with the world. With these merits, I will let you be reborn as a human and avoid falling into the animal world

After speaking, Dai King Yama Gia let his disciple's soul return to the living world.

Disciple   December 12, 2018

Answer: See? Normally, if a person has a dark face and an incomplete soul when you talk to them and they don't respond normally, then that person is about to have trouble. This shows that there are many ghosts attached to their bodies, so they will not see other people's cars and then a collision will occur. This is the fastest way to get rid of many evil spirits who die in such car accidents. What she said was not a joke and Master knows there are people like that.

Bodhisattva said that at the end of the year, many people will be taken away, so why continue to create bad karma? Furthermore, if from the beginning you vow to chant as many Little Houses as possible to repay your unjust bondholder, but then stop practicing, these spirits will prosecute you. As long as the King Yama agrees, they can  enter your body and pull you away. Because you  create the karma of spreading rumors, the things you promised cannot deceive the devil, the devil will harass you.  Little devils are very difficult to deal with. If you promise someone something, they will cling to you and not let go.

8. Travel to Black Rope Hell. The Sinner in the Previous Sentence Ever Created the Karma of Killing A Narrative of the Punishment of Black Rope Hell

December 20, 2018, today the disciples received instructions from the Bodhisattva to go to the underworld to observe the Black Rope Hell and listen to the trial of the Spiritual Dharma disciples who fell into the Black Rope Hell because of creating killing karma.

Black Guy Hell: specializes in punishing souls who kill living beings. Flying into the air above Black Guy Hell, this place looks like a deep underground mountain valley. The special thing is that on the cliffs around the valley there are many guard posts. Between the guard posts there are small bridges connecting each other. On a fairly large flat area of ​​the valley, there is a Diem Palace which is the place where this hell is managed. Below the valley there are winding rivers (not the red lava of the Avīci Hell (Relentless Hell) nor the black liquid of the Plain Hell).

On the surface of the river there is a layer of steam rising, showing that the water here is at a very high temperature. Overcoming the cliffs full of watchtowers is a large flat area, surrounded by giant mountain rocks of different heights and heights surrounding the valley. On the ground of the valley there are many small pillars and pedestals with countless evil spirits scattered everywhere. The devil wields a whip and shouts, forcing the sinner to lie down or tie him to a pole to receive punishment. Miserable wailing sounded each time. It can be seen that this hell does not punish continuously every second and every minute. Will give the sinners a period of rest. After observing the whole scene of hell, the disciples flew towards Palace of King Yama of King Yama

In front of the palace, two ghosts escorted a sinful man to kneel on the ground. This is the criminal in the trial on December 12, 2018 from Truong Gia village XX

The male spirit said:  When I was alive, I was a fish trader and fish killer for decades. After practicing Spiritual Dharma, I learned about cause and effect and retribution, so I didn't dare to do it anymore. Before studying Buddhism, I had a mild stroke. After reciting sutras and studying Buddhism for nearly a year, my illness recovered. Then, because of disagreements with people in the group of fellow practitioners, I became angry and withdrew and slandered the Spiritual Dharma.

After I died in a car accident,  I fell into the Great Hell of Endlessness, after the punishment there ended, the King Yama told me to go to this  Hell to continue to suffer the punishment. I was escorted here by the Devil to meet the King Yama, the Black Guy. He showed me the karma of killing living beings when I was born, the flocks of fish souls of the water tribe that I killed, all black and drawn before the King Yama, the ruler of living beings, to accuse and clearly state my sin of killing living beings and taking my life.  Before I was in trouble, these water tribe spirits gathered together into a giant black mass of spirits that came to earth and entered my body to collect my debt

King Yama Gia said:   Falling into hell is the cause and effect created by you. You were originally saved by Buddha, but because you regressed and did not recite Buddha's name, your body was full of black energy. After a few years of chanting Buddha's name, you could only save a part of the water tribe to reincarnate. The other water tribe souls that you murdered were allowed by Buddha to stay in the underworld and wait for your scriptures to be transcended. The King added to warn people: if people who use killing as their profession recite Buddha's name while still alive, they will need more scriptures than normal people to eliminate the crime of killing. Not just a few hundred repetitions of the 《Rebirth Mantra》 can erase your karma

King Yama Gia turned on the screen for his disciples to see: many water tribe spirits were waiting to be reincarnated in the underworld. The devil used testing equipment and then gave the Little House to the King Yama to manage the animals.  The King Yama will distribute the energy of the scriptures to these water tribe souls. When they receive the energy of the scriptures, they will be reincarnated. The text checking device looks like a human laser photocopier but has no buttons.  The King Yama explained: The Little House's empty circle has no black dots because there is no scripture energy covering it. A good sutra does not show a black dot, but a sparkling golden light in a circle

King Yama continued: Tell yourself about your punishment in Black Rope Hell to warn people not to commit murder. The retribution of killing follows closely like a shadow

The male spirit said: Then I was led by the devil through many lookouts into the Black Rope Hell (Kālasūtra) across high and low valleys to a very large and empty flat land. The tragic scene around me made my whole body tremble. I was tied tightly to a large wooden post by a Devil wielding a whip. This wooden pole was very strange and had small nails stuck in it. I was so scared that my legs were weak and I had no strength to resist. Another Devil turned the hand wheel next to the column, immediately from inside the column large iron nails came out and pierced my whole body.

I don't know how long later I fainted. When I woke up, it was removed from the pole lying on the ground. By the next day (morning in the underworld, the sky was gray and gloomy with no sunlight), my soul recovered completely without any exposed intestines. The devil saw that I was awake and immediately forced me to wake up and repeat the same punishment as the previous day. Just like that, I continuously suffered punishment in hell for I don't know how long I had to be in prison... Every day is worse than death...(sobbing)

Disciple December 20, 2018

The male sinful spirit said: "After the trial on December 10, 2018 ended, the devil immediately escorted me to the Pillar Hell.

"Not long after entering the Pillar Embracing Hell, I couldn't control my lustful thoughts. In my mind, the scenes of sexual misconduct I had committed continuously appeared in my mind. As soon as my delusional thoughts arose, I was pulled by the Devil to hug a red-hot bronze pillar tightly. My whole body was burned in so much pain that I screamed in agony and immediately woke up from my delusions. My skin stuck to the bronze pillar and made a 'sizzling' sound as I was burned. I couldn't help but scream. Crying bitterly. When the thoughts in my head completely disappeared, the bronze pillar immediately became cold; my whole body fell limply to the ground, tears flowed endlessly with immense regret. Not long after, I lost consciousness and fell into a coma.

The next day, the sky is bright, the soul is restored to the way it was when it first entered hell. The ghost saw that I had regained consciousness and pulled me to hug the bronze pillar. Thoughts of lust arose in my head again, my whole body was burned with pain to the point of screaming miserably. Every day is the same, imprisoned in hell and punished..." (crying)

Great Hell King said: "  XXX (female sinner), before studying Buddhism you had committed sexual misconduct with many men. After studying Buddhism, you made a vow before the Buddha not to commit sexual misconduct, to practice purity. But because of fate in this life, you could not control your emotions and broke the precepts of lust, and even had an abortion and killed your life. Therefore, this King sentenced you to the Ice Hell (crime of sexual misconduct) and the Iron Mountain Hell (crime of abortion). )to endure the punishment, now you appear and speak Dharma in the underworld to let the living beings of the world know the consequences of sexual misconduct and abortion, to warn the world not to commit sexual misconduct. Whether you believe it or not, hell is real."

The female spirit said: "I am also a child. After the trial on December 14, 2018, I was sent by the Devil to the Ice Hell. I don't remember how I got to the entrance to the snow mountain, I only know it was a long time ago. Before entering the snow mountain, the clothes on my body were forcibly taken off by the Devil, and given to a female Devil next to me to keep, so that when I get out of hell later. I will wear it again.  I followed the Devil into Snow Mountain Hell, this place is as vast as the Himalayas. The air is bitterly cold, the temperature is nearly minus 30 degrees

Yellow-skinned Asians, blonde-haired, blue-eyed foreigners, black people... there are both men and women, there are young people,  middle-aged people, very few old people. I and other sinners are locked with iron chains; In front there is a ghost leading the way, (the ghost is wearing clothes) walking  in the snowy mountains. I thought that when I died, I wouldn't feel anything anymore, but unexpectedly I still felt as cold as when I was alive.

"The snowy mountain is so vast, sometimes the wind blows strongly, the cold wind hits our face with sharp pain like a knife. The thick snow under our feet makes us walk extremely slowly, in extreme pain. Our skin gradually freezes and cracks, as do our lips. We keep walking, walking, mentally exhausted, but the Devil doesn't let us rest at all."

"I don't know how long I was gone, whether it was a few days, nights or a whole week, and then I returned to the entrance. The devil called the roll call, saying that my punishment in Snow Mountain Hell was over, and I could leave. A female devil ordered me to return my clothes for me to wear, and then I was taken to Iron Mountain Hell."

Different from Snow Mountain Hell,  Iron Mountain Hell are tall iron mountains in the gloomy underground;  hot, humid air. Here there are also male and female sinners of many different races from all over the world gathered to receive punishment.  We were shouted at by the Devil and chased away to climb the iron mountain; At the foot are sharp spikes rising from the ground.  Surrounded by countless ghosts of aborted fetuses,  bleeding, crying bitterly, with sky-high resentment staring at us.

They (the dead fetuses)  know that we are all parents who committed the crime of aborting and killing them in this world.  I was extremely scared, afraid of being found by my aborted child; His whole body trembled, enduring the pain of sharp thorns piercing his feet until he bled profusely, climbing step by step up the iron mountain. "If there is a guilty spirit falling to the ground, the unborn unborn spirits wandering around will take the opportunity to attack and tear us apart, venting their resentment for being killed while still alive. They (the unborn dead) do not distinguish at all who are their biological parents. The ghosts also ignore these unborn unborn babies.  We continued to crawl up the mountain step by step; when we reached the top of the mountain, the ghosts shouted at us to take us down the iron mountain. The suffering is unspeakable, hell! It's so scary. Don't have an abortion. no more! Stop committing sexual misconduct! Look at my retribution, do you still not believe that hell exists?”

(sinful girl cried loudly)

The Great King Yama said: "Considering that after studying Buddhism, you have indeed changed; just because you met the fate of your previous life, you were unable to control yourself, and were seduced by a man, causing the evil result of an abortion that killed your life. During the process of being punished in hell,  you also aroused the mind to repent.  Now I allow you to leave prison and be reincarnated as a human. In the human world, there will be Buddhas and Bodhisattvas who will continue to guide you back to Buddha. To practice, you should follow the Devil's orders"

Thank you Master, Disciple December 21, 2018

22. Travel to the Underworld. Ghosts, thanks to the small house, can escape the suffering of the evil destinies. I hope that Yang people will be diligent in reciting sutras and save their lost relatives.

On February 16, 2019, after the disciple finished burning the collection of scriptures (the Little House (XFZ)) while kneeling to thank Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva for compassionately saving his grandfather's soul, he saw the entire golden Buddha altar shining so brightly that he could not open his eyes. After the golden light dissipated, the disciple sat down to continue chanting the daily exercises. Not long after, his consciousness fell into a state of drowsiness, his soul was released by Dharma Protector Bodhisattva, and he saw his grandfather's soul bathing in the golden light energy kneeling in front of the Buddha altar, bowing his head to thank Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva for his compassion.

In front of the altar, there appeared a passage leading down to the underworld. The disciple's soul followed his grandfather's soul into the passage, drifting down to the underworld. The ghost sent the underworld from afar, leading us to area XXXX of the underworld. The terrain of this place was very similar to the small town where the disciples lived on earth, the only difference was that the buildings were extremely simple and outdated. Grandfather's soul stopped in front of a house made of paper, torn and full of holes.

Grandfather said: "This is the hungry ghost path, the environment in the hungry ghost path is very poor, the houses are full of holes. When the wind blew, we ghosts hid in the house and trembled. When he was transferred from hell to the hungry ghost path and lived here. There are also many gangsters and villains here, and security is very poor." After visiting the Path of Hungry Ghosts, the ghost escorted us to another passage, this is the passage to the upper space.

Grandfather said: "Now let's go see grandmother, relatives over there" Underworld - Underworld.

The terrain here is exactly the same as the hungry ghost realm visited before, the only difference is that the buildings and equipment are modern. The living environment in the underworld is almost identical to ours on earth: there are dim street lights and red lanterns illuminating the roads in residential areas, and inside the buildings there is also a flickering light; the sky was completely black. Arriving at a residential area, my grandmother was waiting outside a row of adjacent houses. As soon as she saw her grandfather and disciple, tears fell from her eyes.

Grandma said: "Your grandfather has finally escaped the punishment of the hungry ghost realm. Thank you to Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva's great compassion, the energy of Little House's scriptures can help us  souls escape the suffering of the evil realm."

My grandfather said: "When he was alive, he did not understand Buddhism and cause and effect, took hunting as a hobby, and killed many creatures (tigers, wild boars, rabbits, pigs, chickens, ducks). When his children were very young, he got cancer and passed away. After death, he was dragged to hell by demons, constantly cutting off his arms and legs, beating his heart, beating his lungs, in extreme pain.

My third uncle believes in Buddha, and every year he goes to the pagoda to attend the Water Luc Dharma Assembly, inviting monks to chant the sutra of transcendence. Each time, he was sent by the Devil to the scene of the Water Luc Dharma Conference, seeing countless crowded souls waiting to be transcended, everyone jostling and competing to move forward. Each time the Water and Green Dharma Assembly bestows golden light and blessings, it can only help him avoid punishment in hell for a few days."

My grandfather continued: "After nearly 5 years of being punished by hell, because he did not do good deeds and did not accumulate merit while living, he fell into the realm of hungry ghosts, living in a state of hunger and thirst every day. Your eldest uncle is very filial and often offers food, but he only has a few hours before his spirit consciousness feels full. When he is escorted back to the realm of hungry ghosts, he continues to suffer hunger and cold.

It was not until the devil arranged for me to return to the earthly world to give me a dream (at the Winter Solstice last year) that I began to recite a few tablets of the Little House's combined scriptures to save us (grandfather and grandmother)."

Grandma said: "I still hope that when you return to this earthly world, you will continue to recite Little House for us, so that life will be a little better. To be able to escape the realm of hungry ghosts, I am truly grateful to Bodhisattva Avalokiteśvara! You have no way of knowing how pitiful it is to be in the realm of hungry ghosts.  Fortunately, our ancestors have accumulated virtue, and in the family there are you and your sister reciting Buddha's name, doing super meritorious deeds for your relatives."

My grandfather said: "I hope that you people of the earthly world will be more filial and diligently recite the sutra of transcendence for sentient beings in the enlightened world. Falling into the three evil destiniess is truly indescribably painful.

The devil said: "Can't say any more, go back, yin and yang are separate."

After speaking, the disciple's soul followed the ghost back to earth. Waking up, I saw the porcelain statue of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva surrounded by golden halos. In the air, music constantly resounded chanting the holy name of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva played at the Dharma assembly.

Disciple: February 17, 2019

February 17, 2019, at 2 a.m., the disciple's soul was brought into the Underworld, to the Palace of the King Yama. The Great King Yama sat on the table, looking at a sparkling golden scroll in his hand, with the dharma seal of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva on it. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva manifests in the sky of the Minh Realm, magnifying golden light, extremely compassionate.

The Great King Yama: "Today I received the dharma decree of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, from XXX pagoda in Loi XX, I ordered three spiritual entities of golden arowanas to come here. Now let them tell themselves about the retribution for why they were made to become giant golden arowanas five meters long."

Golden arowana spirit A: "I was originally an enlightened cultivator (a Taoist priest of a certain sect). After death, I was promoted to heaven and became a Dharma Protector at a temple in place

Unfortunately, after being born in heaven, I did not strictly follow the Taoist rules and forgot what Chan Quan told me not to arbitrarily use my magical powers to interfere with the cause and effect of worldly people. I used the magical arts from practicing Taoism to help many believers make offerings to the X temple to eliminate disasters and solve disasters. Voluntarily intervening in the cause and effect of earthly people.

There are some people who should have been punished and suffered evil consequences right in the human world, but after using my supernatural powers to investigate, I helped them avoid misfortune. The Dharma Protector of the Minh Realm checked the earthly records, discovered that I had broken the heavenly law, immediately recorded my karma, and reported it to Heaven in the Desire Realm.

Heaven sent the Great Protector to capture my spirit body, destroy my spirit body in the sky, eliminate all magic power, and then take me to the underworld to reincarnate as a fish.

Thanks to the good karma I cultivated in my previous life, I was raised in the fish pond of XXX pagoda to avoid being killed by people. In front of the pagoda there is a stone statue of Guan Yin Bodhisattva (Avalokiteśvara). At midnight after the temple closed, my spirit body flew out of the golden arowana's body, knelt before the Bodhisattva statue and kept bowing, every night I knelt and bowed my head in repentance."

King Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva: "In your previous life, when cultivating, you placed too much importance on fame and fortune and offerings, so when you were promoted to heaven to become a Dharma Protector, your human habits were still not completely cut off, so you did not follow the laws of heaven and earth, eventually leading to making a big mistake and falling into the womb of a fish. Now let the pupil record it, so that living beings on earth can use it as an example and clearly see the retribution of the abuse of supernatural powers. When you receive your retribution in this life as a fish, you will return to your human body."

Golden arowana spirit B: "In the 1970s, I was a monk who became a monk, traveling all over the world to practice Zen. One day, while begging for alms, I went to a remote mountain area and stayed at a temple. The temple did not have an abbot, only a few local lay women helped clean and take care of it. Every day I dedicated myself to extensively studying the teachings of Buddhism. In my spare time, I preached the Dharma to the lay women. listen.

There was a female layperson named Vuong who was very interested in Buddhism. often come to the temple to find me and  ask me. Through many conversations, the two sides gradually developed sympathy.  I did not uphold the precepts, and many times violated Buddhist precepts with her, doing lewd things right in the temple room. One night when I woke up, I decided to leave the temple and go to another place to practice penance. At the age of 48, my life span was over. I was locked in an iron chain by the Demon God of the Underworld, led into the Hell of the Manure Cellar to be punished for more than ten years, then reincarnated as a fish, raised in a pond on all four sides, without clothes to cover my body, for people to watch and play with.

Every night when the tourists left, my soul emerged from the fish body, temporarily restored its human form, knelt before the stone statue of Guan Yin Bodhisattva (Avalokiteśvara), bowed his head, and knelt to repent for his past mistakes; At dawn, he returned to the body of the golden arowana to continue receiving retribution."

Golden arowana spirit C: "I am the laywoman named Vuong who broke the great precepts with him (golden arowana spirit B). My marriage is not happy, my husband is a cruel person and whenever he is in a bad mood, he beats his wife. In my free time, I often go to the temple to worship and help work in the temple. Listening to him preach Buddhism every day, I feel that the injustices in my heart for many years have been somewhat opened up. I have great respect for Dharma Master XX. Buddha. The Dharma gave me some peace in my heart, forgetting my worldly troubles. My admiration for the shaman made me unable to control it. I even bought medicine mixed into the drink for the shaman to use. I thought that after breaking the precepts, the shaman would return to the world to marry me in this world, but I was wrong. After the shaman left, I became pregnant; because I was married and had no face to give birth, I went to the clinic for an abortion, just a few months later Having an abortion, I became mentally unstable and crazy.

A year and a half later, I hanged myself at home. After death, I was banished straight to the Manure Hell and the Lava Hell. After completing all the hellish punishment, I reincarnated as a fish.

Every day I see him (the seed in Alaya consciousness) I am both ashamed and resentful, resentful because he left me. At midnight, when his soul came out and bowed, I also followed behind, standing further away, facing the stone statue of Guan Yin Bodhisattva (Avalokiteśvara) and bowing my head in repentance. May the Buddhas be compassionate and merciful to the mistakes I have made."

Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva: "During the Ming and Qing dynasties, you (the spirit of the golden arowana fish B) were once a monarch of a country, very respectful of Buddhist culture, and respectful of saints and sages. This woman is your predestined life. Thanks to blessings and favorable conditions, you will be able to enter the Buddha's door to practice. Unfortunately, after breaking the precepts once and still not maintaining the pure Buddhist precepts, when the retribution of this life is complete, the fish will be reincarnated as a human.

Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva continued: "You (the spirit of the golden arowana fish C) encountered earthly conditions and could not restrain yourself, causing the monks to break the Buddhist precepts. After the retribution of the fish body has been fulfilled, you will be reincarnated back to the human world."

thank you Master, thank you Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva.

Question: On February 18, 2019, at noon, the disciple received the will of Guan Binh Bodhisattva, allowing the disciple's soul to travel to the Underworld - Hell. The judge standing next to him told the guilty spirit that: in the next life, he would have to be reincarnated as a buffalo.

The female sinner cried bitterly, not understanding why she had worked hard all her life and had to receive the retribution of being reincarnated as a buffalo. The judge told the sinner to go in front of the camera. A fluorescent screen shines down above the sinner's head, activating the sinner's soul consciousness (Alaya consciousness). On the screen, a scene of the sinful spirit appeared when she was young: every time a neighbor's relative held a wedding or funeral party, out of kindness, the sinful spirit helped contact the owner of the buffalo farm so that the trader could kill the buffaloes, cows, and goats and bring them to the homes of relatives and friends. The judge told the sinful spirit that: because she did not understand the law and did not know the consequences of killing and killing, there was no need to fall into the Black Rope Hell to suffer. But due to accumulated karma, she still had to reincarnate and fall into the animal world

The disciple saw with his own eyes that in the notebook in the judge's hand, it was written:

“XXX, area XX, Chinese people, karma: indirectly leading to the killing of buffaloes and goats, retribution for reincarnation as buffaloes to receive retribution.

The judge told the ghost to send the guilty spirit to the Palace of King Yama to manage the animal path of life to wait for reincarnation.

The curious disciple asked the judge: If the sentient beings of the Underworld were judged to be reincarnated as animals, how would the process take place?.

The judge opened the screen for the disciples to see. The King Yama, in charge of the animal path, ordered the devil to take a piece of pig skin. On that pig's skin, a portion of the pig's remaining soul consciousness remained. If a living being in the animal world while still in the earthly world is too greedy and kills lives, then after receiving the retribution in the body of an animal, when brought down to be judged based on the sound law, they will be put into a circular cylindrical device to destroy the spirit. Some soul consciousnesses will be collected by the devil and placed on different types of animal skin (pig skin, cow skin, goat skin, tiger skin, wild boar skin, etc.)

The pigskin was forced to cover the criminal's head. Immediately, the sinful spirit was covered by the black gas from the remaining pig skin, and the soul's consciousness became hazy. When you wake up, you will feel like you are a pig. Then the devil will send the sinful spirit to the pig farm to be reincarnated and put into the fetus of a fertilized sow. After 17 weeks, piglets will be born.

After speaking, the judge told the ghost to send the disciple's soul back to the living world.

Thank you Master, thank you Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva.

Disciple February 18, 2019

Answer: One hundred percent true. The radio director tells everyone to listen, everyone must remember. Why did this woman just commit a little crime and have to be reincarnated as a buffalo and fall into the animal path? If in the future she can study Buddhism, cultivate her mind, and recite sutras, then the karma caused by her previously introducing others to marriage, and the karma caused by people killing buffaloes and goats, can be changed? Will she still fall into the animal world?

A pig skin is covered over the body of the person who is about to be reincarnated as an animal. That person still has human form, but the pig skin covering the body cannot be pulled off. They can only wait in line to be reincarnated. Furthermore, before reincarnation, they know very clearly all their conditions: they know who they were before, they know they are about to be reincarnated as a buffalo; very miserable, I don't want to be reincarnated as a buffalo, but once I've lined up, I have no choice but to pull the buffalo skin on my body and I can't get it down.
