Phan Quan said: Because the King Yama in charge of this area has been very busy recently, I was assigned to be in charge of all the cases related to the spirit and body traveling to the underworld to hear the trial. These are the turtle and carp spirit bodies sent down from the positive world by Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, so that they can appear in the underworld and narrate the reason why they fell into the animal body.

Tortoises and grass turtles are turtles released by Spiritual Dharma Buddhists on the full moon day of the first lunar month.

Ba ba said: Before I was reincarnated as a tortoise, I used to be a religious person. I regularly do volunteer work at a religious facility  helping local people perform blessing rituals and exorcisms to eliminate disasters. Later, sexual desire arose when performing a blessing ceremony for women. I pretended that they had evil spirits invading their bodies, then told the believers to give them holy water to drink (mixed with stimulants). While the woman was unconscious, I violated them after they regained consciousness. I threatened and warned them not to tell anyone else. Many victims, because they did not want their family and friends to know, chose to stay silent. Among them, one victim was a young woman. After being abused, she became pregnant and could not hide it from her family, so she told the truth to her parents. My parents were angry and went to the police station to accuse me of being arrested by the police and sentenced to fifteen years in prison.

In prison,  I was often beaten by other prisoners to the point of being half-dead. After I died, I fell into the Pillar-Embracing Hell, and was dragged by the Devil to hug a red-hot iron pillar, burning so much that my skin cracked, my flesh and blood were smeared, and the pain was excruciating. I kept screaming and begging God to save my life, admitting I was wrong. After serving the punishment in hell, I was reincarnated as a turtle, then was caught and killed by fishermen using nets, and brought to a restaurant for people to eat. I don't know how many reincarnations I've gone through and been killed like that.

Grass turtle said:  When I was alive, I opened an aquatic store, specializing in selling turtles (black turtles and tortoises), selling them to restaurants and to religious people for release. Before I died, a large, rotting ulcer developed on my body; I ran everywhere for treatment, sought doctors and medicine, but could not get better, and finally died in extreme pain. After I died, I fell into hell. The devil ordered me to use a knife to cut open my stomach and eviscerate my intestines as punishment for selling turtles to restaurants to make money, causing them to be killed. After serving the punishment in hell, I reincarnated as a black turtle; Ironically, he was sold right into the aquarium store he once opened, so that others could buy it and release it..."

When the grass turtle said this, he couldn't hold back his sadness and burst into tears.

Colorful koi carp said: During the Republic of China, I was born into a rich local family, with an older brother and sister-in-law. My brother is an honest, honest person who regularly gives alms, makes offerings to Buddha, and is vegetarian. Because my brother works far away all year round, I manage the family business and take care of my sister-in-law on his behalf.

Over time, my sister-in-law and I developed a shady relationship. It cannot be said that the servants in the palace knew the truth, but they all pretended not to see or hear. One day my brother came back from another place to discover our relationship. I was afraid that the matter would be exposed, so I panicked and in the chaos killed my brother.

To avoid responsibility, I buried him in the mountains and forests and lied that he had gone away to do business and lost contact. After that, I sold all my assets, moved to another place to settle down, and welcomed my sister-in-law to live with me, taking the title of husband and wife. My brother's unjust soul came before the King Yama to complain, received orders from the King Yama, then returned to the world every midnight to strangle me, causing me constant nightmares and mental collapse. One day I developed a mental illness, poisoned my sister-in-law and killed myself at home, then took medicine to commit suicide. After my death, I was thrown into Heart Surgery Hell, ordered by the devil to cut out my heart and lungs, to punish me for being heartless and heartless, and to destroy my conscience. After my time in hell ended, I was reincarnated as a turtle, and spent my whole life crawling close to the ground, unable to raise my head to look at people. Since that time, I often drive on the road at dusk looking for 'prey' and do many things that are not as good as animals. One afternoon, while walking on the road, I saw two dark shadows rushing towards me. Suddenly the car's brakes were ineffective. I collided with the first truck and was crushed by the truck, dying on the spot.

After I died, I was thrown into the Great Heat Hell (Pillar Hugging Hell), suffering the daily punishment of being dragged by the Devil to hug a red-hot iron pillar, my whole body being burned until my skin cracked, the pain tearing my heart and liver apart and screaming. Coming out of hell, I reincarnated as a perch. I don't know how many generations I've been making perch. When I was alive, I often went to the river to catch and cook this fish. How do I know that it was created by humans?

Phan Quan held the seal and stamped it on the scroll: "Young man, you can leave."

The disciple's soul returns to the earthly world. Woke up from the dream at 4:38 pm.

Disciple: March 27, 2019

Answer: How pitiful. Each person creates his own karma and bears it himself; Although the sky's net is vast, it is sparse but difficult to penetrate. Those who cultivate the mind and become monks must keep strict precepts, this is no joke. Hells like this  Pillar Embracing Hell have been around for a long time. The radio director remembers that about thirty years ago, the radio director witnessed a real incident.

When Master Lu was a child, there was a music teacher. Her husband was a famous and gentle man. No matter how much his wife scolded him, he would just laugh it off. He was a very honest man. Later, when he passed away, when Master Lu returned home to visit relatives, she went to that teacher's house. She knew I could see her, so she asked Master Lu to help her find out where her husband was. As soon as I looked, I saw him holding a heated copper pole. I know your husband is an extremely good person. Since we were young, we have laughed about him being afraid of his wife, but Master Lu, unable to lie, immediately said to her: "Miss, why does your husband have to suffer a punishment like this? This punishment is usually reserved for people who commit sexual misconduct.*

She cried on the spot, and told the Chief that her husband had committed sexual misconduct with his own sister and had given birth to a child. Retribution follows closely like a shadow, even if you want to hide, you cannot escape. Are you not afraid when you hear such stories?

Chief Lu Quan Hoanh currently holds the position of Chairman of the Australian Chinese Buddhist Association, Chairman of the Board of Directors of the Australian Oriental Media Buddhist Dharma Propagation Charity Agency, Chairman of the Australian Oriental Broadcasting Press and Media Group, Justice of the Peace of Australia, title of Datuk of Malaysia, Honorary Visiting Professor of the University of Siena (Italy), holds an Advanced Degree in Psychology in Australia; At the same time, he also holds the position of Chairman of many Chinese associations, and has been a patriotic consul in Australia for more than thirty years.

Chief Lu Quan Hoanh has studied Buddhism and Mysticism since he was young, and has been instructed by high-ranking monks and famous teachers. He used the wonderful Dharma of Buddha, took the "great supernatural powers" of Bodhisattvas to save predestined sentient beings, causing sentient beings to break free of delusion and become enlightened, through studying Buddhism, reciting sutras, and cultivating the mind to change their destiny.

For the past thirty years, Dai Dai Lu Quan Hoanh has worked tirelessly, year-round, without stopping, dedicated to spreading the essence of Buddhism in Australia and around the world, promoting the cause of charity and peaceful cultural exchange, and promoting the harmony of human souls. To date, he has nearly 10 million followers in more than 50 countries and territories worldwide.

For more than thirty years of saving sentient beings for free, Dai Dai Lu has revealed the Bach Thoai Buddha Dharma to Buddhist friends around the world, using the truth of Buddha Dharma to guide modern life, helping countless sentient beings achieve spiritual liberation. In just a few short years, His teachings were printed all over the world. From 2010 up to now, He has held more than two hundred traveling lectures globally in major cities of Australia, New Zealand, the United States (New York, Los Angeles, Boston, San Francisco), Canada (Toronto, Vancouver), Singapore, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and European countries such as England, France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Denmark, Belgium... In more than 30 countries and regions, the lectures have resonated. big, helping 10 million people around the world change their destiny, family harmony, society harmony, world peace. The February 2017 Dharma conference held in Singapore with 80,000 attendees was an unprecedented event. Dai Dai Lu received a warm welcome and love from Buddhist friends around the world, and at the same time received widespread attention and coverage from the international media. Today, "Spiritual Dharma" is raising a vibrant wave of chanting sutras, studying Buddhism, and cultivating the mind all over the world.

Chief Lu himself and the Australian Oriental Media Buddhist Dharma Propagation Charity Agency led by him have donated more than 1 million dollars in charity money to relief activities for natural disasters such as floods, earthquakes, and fires around the world, as well as for the treatment of disabled children, lonely elderly people, and people with depression through major charity organizations.

Thanks to his outstanding contributions to the development of international culture of peace and charity causes, Thai Binh Than Si Lu Quan Hoanh has repeatedly received the title of World Peace Ambassador at international peace conferences held at the United Nations, the US Congress, the Museum of American Tolerance, Berlin (Germany), as well as at the World Congress of Religions in London (UK). In 2015, Mr. Lu Quan Hoanh was honored to receive an award from the US House of Representatives praising his contributions to promoting peaceful cultural exchanges around the world. In 2016, the US Congress awarded a certificate of merit to Thai Binh Than Si Lu Quan Hoanh, recognizing his great contributions over the years to the international community in spreading compassion and harmony and efforts for world peace. The West Orange city government, New Jersey, USA awarded him the Honorary Citizen of West Orange award. In Australia, thanks to his outstanding contributions and public reputation, he was awarded the title "Justice of the Peace" by the Australian Government and awarded recognition by the Australian Parliament. He was also given the honorary title of Datuk for life by the Malaysian Royal Family; became Honorary Visiting Professor at Siena University, Italy. As a world-famous overseas Vietnamese leader and quintessential Chinese, he was specially praised by the Chinese Government and included in the "2014 Yearbook of Chinese People". He attended the 12th United Nations Day of Vesak in 2015 as a special guest. In September 2015, at the invitation of the President of the United Nations General Assembly, His Holiness attended the "2015 United Nations Summit on Culture of Peace" held at the United Nations headquarters, discussing world peace with the President of the General Assembly, Secretary General Ban Ki-moon and key leaders of countries. From 2017 to 2019, His Holiness gave the keynote speech at UNESCO's "Vesak Celebration".

Chief Lu Quan Hoanh always looks back to his fatherland. Over the past decades, he has devoted himself to promoting cultural exchanges between China and Australia, propagating traditional Chinese culture and the essence of Buddhism to the world, helping sentient beings through reciting Buddhist sutras to improve their own destiny, study, work and live better, live a good life, and better serve the development of the country and society.
